title: Farsiris G NDE 8841/8198
content: 8841 I felt a headache and everything was blurry for a second. I went dark. I passed out. When I woke up, I could see my body on the floor. I was standing right next it. It was like I was at two places at the same time. I was tired and could see my friends and the teachers standing around me. They were trying to get me to breathe. A few moments later, I saw the paramedics come down the stairs. I can't remember very vividly, but I think they started CPR right away. I could see my girlfriend crying and wanting to know what was going on. One of the teachers was holding her. I tried to go near her, but I couldn't move. So, I just stared a her for a few moments. When I went back to looking at my body, the paramedics were still giving me CPR. I could feel the paramedic's hand on my chest, pressing. I wanted to wake up, but I was too tired to do anything. I wanted to cry, but I was too tired and too weak to do so. I was thinking about my family and everything that I will miss if I couldn't come back to my body. I was thinking that this is it for my life. I was upset and mad because I didn't get the chance to say goodbye. It was exactly like the time that I didn't get to say goodbye to my grandparents. For a moment, I felt like something touched my hand. I looked down a saw a little boy, who was one or two years old. He could see me. It was a strange feeling; it was like I knew the child, perhaps he was my child? As soon as he touched my hand, it was like some sort of energy entered my body. I was not tired anymore and I could move. I ran to my girlfriend, talked to her and even touched her, but she could see me, hear me, or feel me. I started crying; it was extremely painful. The little boy came to me again and held my hand while pointing at my unconscious body. I saw the paramedics bringing the defibrillator paddles out. I was scared. I looked at the child and he smiled at me; it was in that moment that I knew I had enough energy to go back to my body. I heard someone say, 'Hurry, she is going.' I started running and took a dive into my left thigh. I woke up, breathing really heavily; I was tired again, as if I had been running for hours. I saw the people around me. They were shocked and looked as if they had seen some sort of a miracle. I can't remember what happened after that. I woke up in the hospital. When I asked the doctor why everyone was so shocked, the doctor told me that the paramedics never used the defibrillator paddles. I woke up all on my own.' Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident CPR given. I had a minor accident the week before, but the doctors said everything was okay. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain I could see, here, and feel what was happening around me. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was quicker and more alert. Sounds were very clear, but the images were blurry sometimes. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't know. I was conscious the whole time, just tired. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was blurry for a few seconds and then it went dark. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear everything very clearly and loudly; it was kind of annoying Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt tiredness, madness, sadness, Happiness, love, and refresh when the child touched my body. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events. I thought about a few memories with the people I care about. Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I saw a little boy, that I believe was my child (from the future) Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I wanted to know who the child was. I knew that I have to come back to figure that out. Besides, I didn't want to leave without saying goodbye God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Everything was the same. I could only see them from another point of view. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? I am uncertain if an afterlife exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Uncertain I knew the child. It was like I had love for him, and I knew that he is the reason that I have to come back. I knew the love of my life, my girlfriend. I didn't want to leave her alone; I knew that it would destroy her. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain, sometime I feel like I know when something extremely bad and sad or extremely good and happy is about to happen. I can feel it. But I can't tell is what it is or when it will happen Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real It seemed really real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I am alive and that is why I think it's real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? focus on every possible aspect and not just the mystical aspect of it.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported being 'tired' and unable to move at first; later able to move after the child touched her hand.

arrival.other_being_detail: A little boy, 'one or two years old,' who could see her; she felt she knew him and thought he might be her child (possibly from the future).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Wanted to return to find out who the little boy was and did not want to leave without saying goodbye (especially to her girlfriend).
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She 'started running and took a dive into my left thigh' and then woke up breathing heavily.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out after a headache and brief blurry vision; CPR was given; she reports a minor accident the week before but doctors said everything was okay.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with a little boy (perceived as possibly her future child) who touched her hand and seemed to give her energy to return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at the scene with observation of CPR; encounter with the child; decision/ability to return; re-entry into body.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She described being 'at two places at the same time' (seeing her body on the floor while standing next to it).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reported a toddler-aged boy who could see her and whose touch seemed to transmit energy, after which she could move; she later interpreted him as possibly her child from the future. She also reported re-entering by 'a dive into my left thigh.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “When I woke up, I could see my body on the floor. I was standing right next it. It was like I was at two places at the same time.” “As soon as he touched my hand, it was like some sort of energy entered my body.” “I started running and took a dive into my left thigh.” “I woke up all on my own.”
